هِقَبٌّ Having a large, or ample, throat, (K,) swallowing everything. (TA.) ―
-b2- Large, big, or bulky, and tall, or long; an epithet applied to an ostrich, (Lth, K,) and to other things: (K:) or long, or tall, as an epithet applied to other things than the ostrich. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
